purpose: Held examples for scoring the LiftDesc exit parser (D13). Rows marked live:true are captured from the feed; the rest are hand-written format variants and are marked live:false.
provenance: Rows 1-4: v2/FacilitiesMaintenance, captured live 17 Sep 2026, also in PS2/evidence/FacilitiesMaintenance_20260917T130227Z.json
Rows 5-10: format variants named in trap T20 and decision record §4.3, hand-written to cover shapes the live feed produced on other days
Rows 11-15: multi-exit and spacing variants added with F02. No live row has yet named more than one exit, so these are hand-written too.
expect_blocked_note: expect_blocked is what blocked_exits() must keep her out of — the route outcome, not just the parse. Empty for stations off her route.
